mapper.sql: select id, call_no, customer_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, product_code, model_type, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, total_fees, call_time, call_status, err_msg, raw_price_detail, create_time, deleted from gateway_call_log
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.call_no, a.customer_id, cu.name as customer_name, a.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, a.supplier_account_id, sa.account_name as supplier_account_name, a.product_code, a.model_type, a.prompt_tokens, a.completion_tokens, a.total_tokens, a.total_fees, a.call_time, a.call_status, a.err_msg, a.raw_price_detail, a.create_time, case when u.id is null then 0 else 1 end as reconciled from gateway_call_log a left join crm_customer cu on a.customer_id = cu.id left join crm_supplier s on a.supplier_id = s.id left join crm_supplier_account sa on a.supplier_account_id = sa.id left join crm_contract_usage u on u.call_log_id = a.id
a.deleted = 0 and a.call_no like concat('%', #{callNo}, '%') and a.customer_id = #{customerId} and a.supplier_id = #{supplierId} and a.supplier_account_id = #{supplierAccountId} and a.product_code like concat('%', #{productCode}, '%') and a.model_type = #{modelType} and a.call_status = #{callStatus} and u.id is null and u.id is not null
and a.call_time >= (case when char_length(#{params.beginTime}) <= 10 then concat(#{params.beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') else #{params.beginTime} end)
and a.call_time <= (case when char_length(#{params.endTime}) <= 10 then concat(#{params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59') else #{params.endTime} end)
and a.supplier_id in
#{scopeSupplierId}
order by a.call_time desc, a.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into gateway_call_log ( call_no, customer_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, product_code, model_type, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens,total_fees, call_time, call_status, err_msg, raw_price_detail, create_time, deleted ) values ( #{callNo}, #{customerId}, #{supplierId}, ifnull(#{supplierAccountId}, 0), #{productCode}, #{modelType}, ifnull(#{promptTokens}, 0), ifnull(#{completionTokens}, 0), ifnull(#{totalTokens}, 0), ifnull(#{totalFees}, 0), #{callTime}, ifnull(#{callStatus}, 1), #{errMsg}, #{rawPriceDetail}, ifnull(#{createTime}, sysdate()), 0 )
mapper.select: select a.id, a.call_no, a.customer_id, a.supplier_id, a.supplier_account_id, a.product_code, a.model_type, a.prompt_tokens, a.completion_tokens, a.total_tokens, a.total_fees, a.call_time, a.call_status, a.err_msg, a.raw_price_detail, a.create_time, a.deleted from gateway_call_log a where a.deleted = 0 and a.call_status = 1 and a.call_time >= #{startTime} and a.call_time <= #{endTime} and a.supplier_id = #{supplierId} and not exists (select 1 from crm_contract_usage u where u.call_log_id = a.id) order by a.call_time, a.id limit 20000
select count(1) from gateway_call_log where call_no = #{callNo}
